publish_meta.ig_tiktok_caption: At 17,500 mph, a spacecraft slams into Earth's atmosphere inside a 5,000°F plasma fireball — hotter than molten steel — yet stays room temperature inside thanks to a blunt bow shock and ablative charring. Would you ride a capsule back from orbit? Comment YES or NO.
publish_meta.pinned_comment: Bolt waved goodbye to orbit at 17,500 mph 😂 Would you ride a reentry capsule back to Earth? Comment YES or NO 👇

beats.narration_text: Dropping from orbit at seventeen thousand miles per hour wraps a capsule in five-thousand-degree plasma.
beats.voice_direction: High-stakes aerospace hook; crisp punch on five-thousand-degree plasma.

beats.narration_text: Buckle up, Bolt — wave goodbye to space. Outside burns hotter than steel, yet inside stays cool.
beats.voice_direction: Playful warm cue to Bolt, then awe-filled physics contrast.

beats.narration_text: Most people blame air friction. Actually, extreme air compression ahead of the hull creates that fire.
beats.voice_direction: Sharp myth-busting clarity on extreme air compression.

beats.narration_text: A pointy nose would slice straight into the shockwave and melt. So engineers flip it backward.
beats.voice_direction: Clever paradox reveal; emphasize flip it backward.

beats.narration_text: Entering blunt-end first creates a detached bow shock that deflects ninety-eight percent of the heat.
beats.voice_direction: Analytical awe on detached bow shock and ninety-eight percent.

beats.narration_text: Relax, Bolt — that curve traps a dead-air buffer ahead of you. Still, two percent is brutal.
beats.voice_direction: Reassuring banter to Bolt, then tight pivot on two percent is brutal.

beats.narration_text: For the rest, the capsule wears a three-inch resin honeycomb shield built to burn away on purpose.
beats.voice_direction: Fascinated clarity on burn away on purpose.

beats.narration_text: Outer resin chars into glowing gas, physically carrying heat away while cool layers insulate inside.
beats.voice_direction: Peak energetic physics clarity; punch on carrying heat away.

beats.narration_text: Outside hits five thousand degrees Fahrenheit. Just three inches away inside Bolt's cabin, it stays seventy-two.
beats.voice_direction: Dramatic contrast; crisp punch on seventy-two.

beats.narration_text: Once air brakes away ninety-nine percent of orbital speed, three giant parachutes bloom open.
beats.voice_direction: Triumphant soaring release on three giant parachutes bloom open.

beats.narration_text: Welcome home, Bolt. From a blazing plasma fireball to a gentle seventeen mile per hour splashdown.
Would you ride a capsule back from orbit? Comment YES or NO.
beats.voice_direction: Snappy conversational challenge; crisp lift on YES or NO.
